lines.text: Bablu ne poocha: Tara, tum sochti kaise ho?
Sach bataun? Main bas agla shabd andaaza lagaati hoon.
Jaise koi likhe 'chai ke saath'... toh agla shabd?
Bilkul! Maine crore-on vaakya padhe hain. Toh mujhe pata hai, kaunsa shabd sabse zyada aata hai.
Ek shabd chuna, phir agla, phir agla. Aise hi poora jawaab banta hai.
Toh agar padha hua hi galat ho?
Toh main bhi poore bharose se galat bol sakti hoon. Isliye zaroori baatein jaanch lena.
Par agle din, Tara ne Bablu ko ek aisi tasveer dikhayi, jo kabhi kheenchi hi nahi gayi thi.
Part 5 jald. Follow karo, aur ye us dost ko bhejo jo AI pe aankh band karke bharosa karta hai.
